Nika is a screen reader based on Backtalk and Google TalkBack.

New in this version:
• Action "Switch focus: text field and keyboard" (section Focus in the gesture list).
• Gemini buttons: the words match the real names in the Gemini app.
• The volume keys screen no longer has the diagnostics switch.
• The main settings heading "Feedback" is now "Settings".
Write to the developer: report a problem or suggest an idea
